data.acquisitionSummary: Current Sunrise Prepaid has no monthly fee; activation including SIM/eSIM costs CHF19.90 with CHF20 starting credit. Sunrise now directly states that a prepaid number is released after 17 months with no active use. Online eSIM registration can use a foreign address.

keep.action: Perform any qualifying active use before 17 months elapse. Sunrise explicitly counts a credit top-up, outgoing call, mobile-data use, outgoing SMS, or option/bundle purchase as active use. Online top-up starts at CHF10 and works abroad with a saved card.

data.chinaActivation: Sunrise currently supports online prepaid eSIM registration with a foreign address and online activation. Physical SIM delivery is limited to Switzerland/Liechtenstein. Exact successful China-first registration/OTP use is not independently reproduced in the reviewed evidence.
data.kyc: A valid identity document is required for prepaid registration/activation. The current travel-eSIM flow permits a foreign address; do not interpret this as no-KYC.
data.payment: Online top-up starts at CHF10 and can be initiated in Switzerland or abroad; saved Swiss and foreign payment cards are supported subject to current limits.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Sunrise supports prepaid roaming. A current 2026 community troubleshooting thread states ordinary SMS should be receivable while roaming with network signal and roaming enabled, but route-specific China OTP reliability is not established.
data.refund: Prepaid SIM/credit return is generally not available; current provider terms govern exceptions.
data.holdReason: The old 12-month rule is resolved to a 17-month inactivity rule and foreign-address eSIM registration exists, but current independent China-first activation plus long-term OTP evidence is still insufficient for promotion.
data.tariffSummary: CHF19.90 activation incl. CHF20 credit; number released after 17 months without active use; CHF10 top-up is one qualifying activity and can be done abroad.
guideSteps: Register the prepaid eSIM online with a valid identity document; foreign addresses are supported by the current eSIM flow.
Perform a qualifying active use before 17 months of inactivity; a CHF10 top-up is the lowest current top-up.
Treat China/OTP reliability as unverified until current independent evidence exists.
